name: Fish
overview: Scripture reveals that fish were created by God as part of His abundant creation in the waters, as seen in Genesis 1 where God commanded the waters to bring forth living creatures and blessed them to multiply. God granted humanity dominion over the fish of the sea, indicating their place under human stewardship (Genesis 1:28). After the flood, God explicitly appointed fish and all moving creatures as food for mankind, demonstrating His provision and sovereignty over creation (Genesis 9:2-3). Thus, fish hold a significant role both in the created order and in God's provision for His people.
